revisions.reason: Initial investigator, A3, A4 and A-prior prompts, tool schemas, operation vocabulary and model settings, committed before any live discovery or A-prior run.

Add the repeated-call note and the stall stop after the live adaptive run run-35859e64 ended at 15 calls with no hypothesis; the A-prior runs ran under revision 1, whose prior-arm prompt differs from revision 2 only by the repeat note.

Publish the engine's start, gate and trigger rules as a neutral block in get_workflow_definition and hash it with the tools; from the second experiment on, require two active hypotheses whose if_true predictions do not overlap on one metric for a shared pool case, or a stated no_pair_reason, counted apart when refused; describe the identical-event-log data in run_experiment. Reason: in the L2.1 adaptive run (revision 2) every experiment left the event logs identical without the result saying so, the start rules were not shown to the model, and no hypothesis pair could be told apart by any experiment.

Shrink the investigator's context: context_chars 60000 to 24000 counting call arguments, a 40000-character history cap that drops whole older turns with one note, the definition shown whole once and then in short form, per-tool short forms for older results, experiment cases without the duplicate intervention metrics, timeline pages capped at 8000 characters; record_hypothesis now names the field that held an unknown id. Reason: the L2.1 adaptive run averaged about 42k prompt tokens a call and lost 9 calls to unknown_id answers on evidence it could not locate.

Keep the newest turn outside the context caps, cap one turn's timeline pages near 20000 characters, keep the definition and case-list short forms when older turns drop, keep event ids in timeline short forms; context_chars 12000, history_chars 28000. Reason: live run run-7b5830ad under revision 4 thrashed: one turn of five or six timeline pages passed the 40000-character history cap by itself, so every older turn was dropped on each call and the model re-read the case list, definition and requirements every other turn (30 calls, no hypothesis); it was stopped and counts as run 1 of 3.

Give the investigator memory that survives compaction: a record_note tool (600 characters, 20 notes) whose notes are logged, deny-list scanned and shown as a numbered list after the kickoff on every later call; results on any case an active hypothesis cites stay whole and their turns drop last; caps loosened about 2.5x (context_chars 30000, history_chars 70000), the newest turn still outside all caps. Reason: under revision 5 runs run-a8abc392 and run-841b4fa7 read for 60 calls at about 18k prompt tokens a call, re-read the definition 21 to 24 times and restarted their plan, and recorded no hypothesis; the context cut had removed the model's memory of its own reading. No prompt sentence changed.

Stop the definition re-read loop and budget reads before a hypothesis, in the tool layer: the definition short-form note now states what it leaves out instead of inviting another call, and adds the operation shapes; a repeat get_workflow_definition answers unchanged with the turn and hash of the first read and no body, counted; until a hypothesis is recorded, get_case_timeline and get_record share a window of 25 timeline pages or 12 model calls, after which they refuse (counted, no experiment used) until a hypothesis or a record_note with a no_hypothesis_reason. Reason: revision 6 runs run-b41ebef2 and run-22009f5a read for 60 calls and re-read the definition 21 and 24 times with it already in context. Control disclosure: before this revision, run run-54ff5a29 was made as a control against revision 2 (hash b317394e616d, L2.1's prompt, tools and 60000-character elision) from a detached checkout of commit 96effde, to separate method from run-to-run variance; it recorded 3 hypotheses and ran 2 experiments, its first hypothesis at turn 42 of 60.

Budget hypotheses before an experiment and show the hypothesis shape on a schema error, in the tool layer, keeping all of revision 7: in the adaptive arm, once 3 active hypotheses have been recorded since the last experiment, record_hypothesis and the case reads (timeline, record, intervals, queue, staff) refuse, counted and using no experiment, until run_experiment runs or a record_note carries a no_experiment_reason, and the window resets after each experiment; a record_hypothesis schema error now lists each failing field with its expected type and an example that uses the refund voucher steps and the edge e99, and schema errors are counted per run. Reason: revision 7 run run-561dc2dd recorded 21 hypotheses from 35 attempts (10 schema errors) and never called run_experiment, so the stall moved from reading to recording.

Revision 9 (lane E6.d, from the research note on why the investigator stalls). Control structure: the adaptive arm runs as an investigation cycle owned by code (observe, construct and run, interpret); the controller offers each stage's tools only, opens every cycle with a fresh conversation, and carries forward a ledger the session fills from tool results (observations, hypotheses with predicted size, falsifying experiment and what a null result would mean, experiments with receipts, proposals); cycle 0 states and tests the prior as hypothesis one. The read budget, the hypothesis window, the pair gate and the note windows are removed. Tool interface: run_experiment names the step behaviour it expects to move and returns a receipt (rules changed, the named behaviour per case in both versions, delivered k of n, first event divergence, outcome); a deterministic pre-run lint refuses a change that leaves every step's start and completion rule equivalent, one whose cited hypotheses cannot be told apart on its cases, or a repeat, with the reason as data; get_derived_statistics gives per-step waiting, critical-path membership and the ranked critical segments; choose_question records the cycle's question. Evaluation logic: the prediction check counts an experiment only when its named behaviour moved, and only on the cases where it moved, so an undelivered change never supports or counts against a hypothesis. Effort is set per run, medium or high. Three short live probes before this revision (run-9b0be001 to run-9b0be003, 1, 16 and 20 calls, $0.74, not counted) exposed two interface defects fixed here: a choose_question refusal now lists each pair's allowed delta ranges and overlap, and a refused request no longer moves the controller out of the construct stage.

Revision 10 (lane E6.d, step 2). Tool interface only, keeping all of revision 9: run_sweep runs every legal single operation of the kinds the investigator names that touches the scope steps (both steps of the top_k critical segments, or target_steps) and every pair of them on the same cases and seeds, skipping cells the definition rules refuse and not running cells the static test calls a no-op, and returns counts, the best cells by summed wait delta and delivered cells whose wait did not move, each with a delivered flag; it treats every operation alike, takes at most 60 singles, runs at most three times a session and uses no experiment, and it is reported as an assisted system. get_precondition_table publishes the engine's start, completion and trigger rules and, per operation kind, when its edit can reach the engine; the run_experiment lint applies the same test, and a test checks the static no-op verdict against the simulator over every edge removal, trigger and move on the pool. Both join the construct stage. Evaluation logic: three simulator variants with planted answers of one, two and three operations on different steps (claim cover, discharge summary, refund voucher) and an answer-invariance test asserting that every prompt, tool description, stage text and generated table the model sees is byte-identical across them; the deny-list scan stays and now also covers the statistics, sweep, precondition, experiment and question outputs. Step 1 ran under revision 9 before this revision existed: 6 runs, 3 at medium and 3 at high.

Revision 11 (lane E6.d, after the revision 9 and 10 runs). Tool layer only, keeping all of revision 10: an experiment operation whose target step is not a non-external prepare_document step is now refused by the uncounted pre-run lint (reason not_preparable, with the operation index and step) instead of by the definition rules, where it counted toward the three-refusal lockout. Three of the twelve revision 9 and 10 runs had delivered the planted change and then locked out on exactly this request (retriggering the hand-over step after an edge removal the lint had called a no-op). The run_experiment description and the experiment sentence of the system prompt name the new lint refusal; nothing else changes. In the same commit the evaluator's dev gate gains documents_kept (not a commitment change): a proposal fails when a ward-required document whose final the base completed is not completed under it.
